executive_summary: The Board of Finance held its regular monthly meeting on June 10, 2026, where they approved previous meeting minutes and received updates on the fiscal 2025 audit progress and pension audits. The board also approved an employment contract for a Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion officer and additional appropriations for state and federal grants. The meeting was efficient, with all items on the agenda addressed and passed unanimously.

key_topics.summary: The board approved the minutes from the May 14th regular meeting and the May 18th special budget meeting.
Teresa Viscarello provided an update on the progress of the fiscal 2025 audit and pension audits, indicating that they are on track for completion by the end of July.
The board approved the employment contract for the Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion officer, aligning its term with the mayor's tenure.
Anita presented a request for an additional appropriation of $62,566 from a state grant for quality enhancement funding, which was approved.
The board approved an additional appropriation of $324,646 for the Stanford Police Department from a federal grant to support the Behavioral Health Unit.
